dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Wait... what? You're hitting the hay already?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Come on, sleep is for the weak! Not champions like you and I! You wanna play some Hide-and-Seek?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Playing at night takes it to a whole other level. Seriously, I'm preparing to go full oni on you here — so make sure you find a good hiding spot, capiche!?
